what: The cursor becomes four accent-colored corners. Normally a 5px box sticks to ±5px with no delay. Over links and buttons it opens to ±20px and a 10px box in .3s power2.out, and the label (data-cursor-label) turns on in .18s. Each time the cursor moves over 100px on the board (300ms apart, 150ms after it stops), a 10px marker with x and y coordinates grows in .25s at that spot, stays for 3 seconds, then disappears at once, and a dotted line (3 and 4 dots) connects the last marker to the cursor. When all markers have faded, the dotted line folds toward the cursor in .3s power2.in. Pressing scales it .9x (.15s)

options.spread: Corner distance above the pressed item (px), default 20
options.hot: Corner spacing above the pressable element (px), default 10
options.dist: Travel distance for dropping the marker (px), default 100
options.targets: Selector for what gets triggered, default a, button, [role=button], [data-cursor-label]
options.data-cursor-label: (attribute) text to show as a label under the cursor when hovering over it

note: On touch devices (hover false) nothing is attached. Outside the panel the cursor is hidden and no marks are dropped
